mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high employment (PAYEMS > 147000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.3) signal robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 147000 and UNRATE < 5.3.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 270 indicates elevated inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that compress equity multiples and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 270.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (index 2017=100) indicates sustained manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1500 (thousands of units) signal strong consumer demand for residential construction, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and retail sales (RSAFS > 600000) indicate robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 600000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (index 2017=100) sustained over multiple months supports long-term economic expansion, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.
